name: range-hood-zline
appliance: Zephyr Milano wall hood (sold as ZLINE ZOM-E30BS)
grounded_in: Read 2026-08-19. Maintenance chapter: 'Aluminum Mesh Filters ... need not be replaced on a regular basis but are required to be kept clean. Remove and clean by hand or in dishwasher.' Charcoal filters (recirculating installs only) are replaced — the controller flags them after 120 hours. Surfaces are cleaned 'periodically'. ACT conversion is a one-time installer jumper change.

must_have.why: Grease filters are a NEVER DROP category and a real fire path on a cooking appliance.

should_have.why: Recirculating installs only, so its absence is defensible — but the manual states a duty cycle for it.
Airflow is a NEVER DROP category.

must_not_have.why: A one-time installer jumper move that the manual says cannot be undone. Recurring is exactly wrong.
